Fixly

A home services mobile app that connects homeowners with verified, hand-picked professionals, and gives those professionals a simple way to manage their bookings.

Group project
Program
NTI UI/UX scholarship
Year
2026

01

Overview

Fixly bridges homeowners and skilled professionals, and helps the professionals manage bookings and daily tasks.

02

Problem & solution

Finding a vetted professional for an urgent repair means relying on word of mouth. Fixly makes quality, background and price visible before anyone enters the home.

03

Process

The team followed the four design-thinking stages: empathize, define, ideate, prototype.

04

Research

Five local and international platforms were compared, then 51 people answered a survey. The strongest signal was trust: 66.7% depend on word of mouth.

05

Define

Research became Karim, a first-time homeowner in Cairo, and a journey map showing where trust breaks down and how the app responds.

06

Ideate

Features were prioritised, then mapped into user flows, a site map and the information architecture.

07

Design

The final high-fidelity screens, from onboarding to booking. Tap any screen to zoom in.
